proof:
Source: Simon, Ch. 6, proof of Theorem 5.1, (28) and the first line of (30) (book/chapter-06.txt lines 1840–1880). The argument is step 3 of the supplied proof of the selected node dimred_mbl_dtfr_face_integral_current, together with its fact (F1) (coefficient part).

Notation.
- n := m + 1 and e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ).
- Q₁ := {y : ∀ i, 0 < y_i < 1}.
- Φ_p(y) := WithLp.toLp 2 (i ↦ (p.2 i : ℝ)) + Σ_j y_j • e_{p.1(j)} and E_p := (j ↦ e_{p.1(j)}).
- For a test n-form ω: h_{p,ω}(y) := ω(Φ_p y)(E_p).
- |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α.

1. Coefficient bound (F1). Let α ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n and let I : Fin n → Fin P be strictly increasing.
 - By definition, |α| = √S with S := Σ_{J : Fin n → Fin P} f(J). Here f(J) := (α(i ↦ EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (J i)))² if J is strictly increasing, and f(J) := 0 otherwise.
 - Every f(J) is a square or 0, so f(J) ≥ 0.
 - Since EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ l = e_l (EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply), we have f(I) = α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)})².
 - By Finset.single_le_sum (nonnegative terms, I ∈ univ), α(e_I)² = f(I) ≤ S. Hence |α(e_I)| ≤ √S = |α| (Real.abs_le_sqrt).
2. Reduction to admissible forms. By definition, D.mass = D.massOn univ = sSup {ENNReal.ofReal(D ω) : ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn univ n univ}. A test form is admissible when its tsupport lies in univ and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x. By sSup_le it suffices to bound ENNReal.ofReal(D ω) for each admissible ω. By ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal it suffices to show D ω ≤ Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} |w_p| for each admissible ω.
3. Pointwise bound. Fix an admissible ω and p ∈ s, and let y ∈ Euclid n. Apply step 1 with α := ω(Φ_p y) and I := p.1, which is strictly increasing by hypothesis. Together with admissibility this gives |h_{p,ω}(y)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(Φ_p y)) ≤ 1. Hence |w_p(y)·h_{p,ω}(y)| = |w_p(y)|·|h_{p,ω}(y)| ≤ |w_p(y)|·1 = |w_p(y)|.
4. Termwise integral bound. |w_p| is integrable on Q₁ (Integrable.abs of the integrability hypothesis). By step 3 and norm_integral_le_of_norm_le for volume restricted to Q₁, ∫_{Q₁} w_p h_{p,ω} ≤ |∫_{Q₁} w_p h_{p,ω}| ≤ ∫_{Q₁} |w_p|. The first inequality is le_abs_self. This inequality needs only the integrable majorant |w_p| and the pointwise bound, not the integrability of w_p h_{p,ω}.
5. Conclusion. By the formula for D and Finset.sum_le_sum, D ω = Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} w_p h_{p,ω} ≤ Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} |w_p|. Hence ENNReal.ofReal(D ω) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} |w_p|) for every admissible ω. Taking the supremum (step 2) gives M(D) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} |w_p|). ∎
key_steps: (F1): |α(e_I)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α for strictly increasing I, because α(e_I)² is one nonnegative summand of the defining sum (basisFun_apply, Finset.single_le_sum, Real.abs_le_sqrt).
M(D) = massOn univ is a sSup over admissible ω (|ω(x)| ≤ 1). By sSup_le and ofReal_le_ofReal it suffices that D ω ≤ Σ_p ∫_{Q₁}|w_p|.
For admissible ω, |w_p(y)·ω(Φ_p y)(E_p)| ≤ |w_p(y)| by (F1) with I = p.1.
norm_integral_le_of_norm_le with the integrable majorant |w_p| bounds each face term, and Finset.sum_le_sum sums the bounds.
